about.description: Equity-index perpetual market tracking the XYZ100 benchmark, a broad public-equity basket used by trade[XYZ]. Users get synthetic index exposure rather than ownership of constituent shares, with pricing referencing an external index methodology. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the xyz namespace, but are operated by trade[XYZ] rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
